The rename from `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers` to `@cloudflare/vitest-plugin` is mostly a package-name change, and the configuration stays the same.

**What changed**
- Cloudflare's changelog says Version 1 of the Workers Vitest integration is now published under the new name, and that the Vitest configuration API did not change. Existing projects still need to update the dependency name, imports, and TypeScript types entries. (Version 1 of the Workers Vitest integration is published as @cloudflare/vitest-plugin; The Vitest configuration API is unchanged. Existing projects must update the dependency name, package imports, and TypeScript types entries.)
- The official migration page says the new package takes the old one's place, and that the package API and Vitest configuration are unchanged. (@cloudflare/vitest-plugin replaces @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers. The package API and Vitest configuration are unchanged.)
- The `cloudflareTest()` Vite plugin you use in your config is therefore still the same call.

**How to migrate**
- Automatic route: run the codemod from the project root with `npx @cloudflare/codemods vitest:pool-workers-to-vitest-plugin` (or the yarn/pnpm equivalent). It updates the dependency, imports, and test TypeScript configuration. You can preview changes with `--dry-run` and limit files with `--files <glob>`. (Use --dry-run to preview the changes. Use --files <glob> to limit the files the codemod updates.)
- Manual route: update the package name in `package.json`, the imports, and the test `tsconfig.json`. The same rename applies to subpath imports, such as `@cloudflare/vitest-plugin/config`. (The same rename applies to subpath imports, including @cloudflare/vitest-plugin/config.)
- Outbound request mocking: the official changelog points to the `@msw/cloudflare` integration for mocking outbound requests in Workers tests. (For outbound request mocks in Workers tests, use the @msw/cloudflare ↗ integration.)

**Caveats**
- A third-party analysis (eCorpIT) reports that Cloudflare's guide tells users to pin `^0.16.0`, while the final release of the old package was 0.22.0. It also says the old package has no npm deprecation notice. I could not confirm these details from Cloudflare's own pages, so treat them as unverified. (Cloudflare's own migration guide tells you to replace "@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers": "^0.16.0", a version published on 5 May 2026, while the final release of the old package is 0.22.0 from 18 August 2026.)
- If you're still on Vitest 3, note that v0.12.x is the last version supporting it. The move to the Vite plugin model (v0.13) was the earlier breaking change, which is separate from this rename. (v0.12.x is the last version to support Vitest 3.x.)
